question: Should completion accounting fail or fall back when automatic/message-tool evidence is incomplete or mismatched for a concrete requester route, given the separate requester-wake versus visible-failure lifecycle proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85308?
rationale: The patch’s route-matching mechanics are concrete, but whether a mismatch should initiate direct fallback, terminal visible failure, or another lifecycle outcome is a compatibility decision spanning two active delivery proposals.

options.title: Align with explicit visible failure
options.body: Define mismatched or incomplete required route evidence as visible-delivery failure and ensure this branch composes with the requester-wake lifecycle in the related PR.

options.title: Keep targeted fallback semantics
options.body: Accept direct fallback for the documented generated-media cases, but specify and test the exact cases where fallback is allowed instead of a terminal failure.

options.title: Pause for a unified delivery design
options.body: Hold both overlapping proposals until one owner documents the completion-delivery state machine and settles fallback versus terminal-failure behavior.

recommendation.title: Align with explicit visible failure
recommendation.body: Define mismatched or incomplete required route evidence as visible-delivery failure and ensure this branch composes with the requester-wake lifecycle in the related PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged account-bound route work is the closest available current-main history for deciding the route-isolation invariant.
